NOT-A-BUG: already-fixed / duplicate. Verified non-reproduction on current origin/main (de8801d).

Proven root cause (mechanism): the doc/code contradiction was real when this ticket was filed (2026-08-27 18:30 UTC) but has since been reconciled. Both sides now AGREE on origin/main:
- Code: scripts/mutation_gate.py:594-596 -> 'sys.prefix is deliberately absent' comment + 'sandbox_allow = (root, basetemp)'.
- Doc: docs/local-dev-env.md:132-134 -> 'The venv is deliberately EXCLUDED from that allow-list: a writable venv would let a mutant drop executable code into site-packages for a later un-sandboxed phase to import.'

Proof (which side is authoritative + how reconciled): the code's exclusion is the deliberate, cited security behavior (incident-driven, e668). The fix was a DOCS correction that aligned docs/local-dev-env.md to the code. It landed as commit 6a1f722f7881 ('Surface the sandbox's residual gaps', 2026-08-28 06:10 UTC), which carries trailer 'rebar-ticket: baf9-eea0-4b8d-42a4' (Gerrit change 2311). That commit's diff removes 'and the venv' from the deny-writes-outside list and adds the deliberate-exclusion sentence + reason -- satisfying BOTH ACs of this ticket (docs match code; reason stated so nobody re-adds it).

Defect origin / duplication: this ticket duplicates finding #1 / AC1 of baf9-eea0-4b8d-42a4 (both discovered_from e668-b496-e264-4283). baf9's change 2311 fixed the exact wording this ticket reports.

Test: N/A -- docs-only reconciliation, no code change (repo policy: documentation changes need no test; confirmed no doc-lint asserts this line).

Siblings swept: grep of origin/main for venv+allow-list+site-packages+sandbox across docs and scripts shows only docs/local-dev-env.md (now corrected) and docs/mutation-testing.md (records read/network posture, does NOT claim the venv is writable) -- no other doc repeats the wrong allow-list contents.

Disposition: closing as --class=duplicate with a 'duplicates' link to baf9-eea0-4b8d-42a4 (live replacement). No --force used.
